title: Company | Joby Aviation – Building the Future of Electric Air Taxi Travel | Joby Aviation

headings.text: It’s time to dream bigger. Our vision is to save a billion people an hour a day.
We’re a community of engineers and visionaries bringing the dream of everyday flight to life through world-class manufacturing and technology.
Designing cleaner flight for people and the planet.
